rows.ARS:
Orange blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Fay's Folly
rows.Origin:
Bred by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, before 2002).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2002 as 'Fay's Folly'.
rows.Bloom: Orange blend. Tangerine orange fading to cream at ghe edges. None / no fragrance. Double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Compact, dense.

Height: up to 4' (up to 120cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
